scope: M149 exact sealed VCS/DC identity audit, fresh exact production VCS/DC replay, independent signed arithmetic and destination-fold hammer, invalid-shape/reset/stall protocol composition, and M147 1.805434x admission closure.

score.disposition: GO for the nominal legal-input 4x96 signed destination-fold arithmetic kernel and its logic-only 3 ns DC point after preserving the stated narrow scope. NO-GO for protocol integration until held-output loss is repaired. NO-GO for the M147 1.805434x ratio, four executable updates per cycle, matched-frequency speedup, physical speedup, system speedup, paper PPA or headline use.

independent_vcs_hammer.destination_assignment_definition: Every destination assignment for all four legal prefix shapes: 8 + 8^2 + 8^3 + 8^4.
independent_vcs_hammer.signed8_value_negate_sweep: All 256 signed-8 values under all 16 negate masks for an all-same destination, plus lane-varying traffic.

production_sva_composition_replay.purpose: Attach the frozen production SVA to the independent invalid-input plus held-output attack.
production_sva_composition_replay.interpretation: The legal result was valid and stalled, then disappeared without result_accept when an unrelated illegal descriptor latched fault.

m147_admission_audit.reason_not_closed: M149 starts after all four 96-lane signed-8 vectors are preavailable on a 3072-bit input interface. It contains no vector generation or weight/PWP storage, no SRAM ports, no M148 integration, and no accumulator commit capable of consuming up to four non-prefix destination groups per cycle.

findings.title: Illegal input destroys a previously accepted legal result under backpressure
findings.evidence: The independent test accepted a legal descriptor with result_ready=0, established result_valid=1 without result_accept, then presented invalid shape 0101. On the next edge RTL set fault_q and result_valid_q=0. A second run with frozen production SVA failed ap_result_payload_stable_under_stall at 33253500 ps.
findings.impact: The current fail-closed input path is not transaction-safe: an upstream protocol violation can silently erase an unrelated result already owed to the downstream consumer.
findings.required_action: Separate input quarantine from buffered-output retirement. Preserve and expose the held result until result_accept, or add an explicit acknowledged abort/flush contract. Add invalid-plus-held-output and invalid-plus-same-cycle-retire cases to the production seal.

findings.title: The arithmetic island does not close M147's four executable updates per cycle assumption
findings.evidence: M149 proves one descriptor per cycle only after 4 x 96 x 8 = 3072 contribution bits are already present. The frozen contract explicitly excludes weight/PWP storage, SRAM ports, accumulator commit and M148 integrated RTL. Up to 4 x 96 x 11 = 4224 result bits can require retirement in a distinct-destination descriptor.
findings.impact: Local same-destination folding removes M148's arithmetic omission, but it does not prove that the workload can fetch, form and commit every descriptor in one cycle. The corrected M147 1.805434x opportunity remains inadmissible.
findings.required_action: Integrate an exact M148-to-M149 vector supply and a mask-aware banked commit path, price ports/bandwidth/backpressure, and replay measured accepted-descriptor recurrence before admitting any cycle ratio.

findings.title: First-occurrence output groups are legal but non-prefix
findings.evidence: Exhaustive 8^4 destination assignment testing observed every possible first-owner mask with bit 0 set, including gapped masks 0101, 1001, 1011 and 1101. This is the correct stable-first-occurrence behavior of the frozen RTL.
findings.impact: Any downstream block that interprets group count as a valid prefix will drop or misroute groups even though the M149 interface carries an explicit valid mask.
findings.required_action: Freeze a full-mask consumer contract and test the integrated commit path against every gapped mask; do not compact or prefix-decode implicitly.

findings.title: Production VCS omits the protocol composition that violates production SVA
findings.evidence: The sealed test runs 72 descriptors and attacks only invalid shapes 0101 and 0000 after draining/reset. The independent test checks all 12 invalid shapes and the invalid-plus-held-output case that triggers the frozen stall-stability assertion.
findings.impact: The sealed PASS is reproducible but does not establish the broad fail-closed streaming contract.
findings.required_action: After RTL repair, port all invalid shapes, held-output composition, same-cycle retire, reset and gapped-mask partitions into the exact-SHA production regression.

findings.title: No completed RTL-to-mapped-netlist Formality admission is present
findings.evidence: Fresh RTL VCS and DC mapping reproduce, and mapped Verilog/SDC/DDC/SVF exist, but the reviewed M149 evidence contains no completed Formality receipt.
findings.impact: The mapped QoR point is not yet independently tied to RTL functional equivalence.
findings.required_action: Run exact-identity RTL-to-final-mapped-netlist Formality after the protocol fix and reseal the repaired revision.

findings.title: The 30,958.7 um2 DC point is logic-only and prephysical
findings.evidence: Fresh DC exactly reproduces 30,958.703937 um2, 24 logic levels, +1.0787 ns setup and +0.0221 ns hold at 3 ns, but uses ideal clock, ZeroWireload and zero macros with no SAIF/PTPX or routed timing.
findings.impact: The result is useful standalone module evidence, not physical energy, frequency, throughput or paper-PPA evidence.
findings.required_action: Keep this number logic-only; add realistic source/commit integration, propagated-clock STA and activity-based power before any physical efficiency claim.

validated_strengths: Independent arithmetic oracle found zero mismatches across 4,222,080 lane/group comparisons.
Signed-8 extension and 9-bit negate preserve -(-128)=+128; 10-bit pair and 11-bit final sums exactly cover -512 through +512 without saturation.
Every legal destination assignment and all stable-first-owner output masks were exercised, including gapped masks.
Nominal one-entry elastic operation sustains descriptor II=1 when the consumer is ready and holds all checked payload lanes during ordinary stalls.
Sealed manifests verify and fresh Synopsys VCS/DC replays reproduce the frozen functional and synthesis evidence exactly.
Existing M149 contracts correctly keep the M147 ratio, physical/system speedup, paper PPA and headline fields false.

admitted: Nominal legal-input 4x96 signed-8 contribution fold with stable first-occurrence destination ownership
Exact 9-bit negate, 10-bit pair sums and 11-bit result range without saturation
One accepted descriptor per cycle for preavailable input vectors when result_ready remains asserted
Flattened TSMC28 standard-cell logic-only area and ideal-clock ZeroWireload timing at 3 ns
not_admitted: Transaction-safe invalid-input quarantine while an output is held
Integrated M148 vector generation or supply
3072-bit input delivery from SRAM or PWP/weight storage
Up to four destination accumulator commits per cycle
Routed timing, SAIF/PTPX energy, paper PPA, DATE headline or best-paper readiness
